---
title: "Room Adventure...Revolutions"
---

## Overview

In this activity, you will build a text-based adventure game in Java called **Room Adventure**. The game takes place in a small mansion made up of several rooms. The player can move between rooms, observe items in each room, and pick up items to add to their inventory.

Unlike the previous Room Adventure activity, which was written in Python, you will build this entire game in a **single Java file** called `RoomAdventure.java`. That file will contain two classes:

- **`Room`** — represents a single room in the mansion
- **`RoomAdventure`** — contains the main game loop and all game logic

This activity will help you become more familiar with the following:

- Classes
- Instance Variables
- Defining Constructors
- Static (class-level) variables and constants
- Arrays
- Loops
- Conditionals
- User input with the `Scanner` class

::: {.callout-tip}
Throughout this activity you will see notes comparing Java to Python. These are here to help you connect what you already know to what is new.
:::
